docs.title: Projets
docs.text:
• Learning Arduino with Registers

    Low-level programming for AVR micro-controller (ATmega328P) using registers.

    See documentation View code on GitHub

  • Sensorless FOC ESC

    Design of a sensorless FOC (Field Oriented Control) ESC for a single BLDC driver.

    See documentation View code on GitHub

  • Quad-rotor ESC

    Design of a quad-rotor sensorless FOC ESC .

  • Mobile robotics

    Design of a mobile platform that allow either differential drive or omnidirectionnal drive. Study of Data Fusion (Kalman Filter, ...) and Navigation Algorithms (SLAM)
